description: Replaced spindle bearings, aligned tool turret, and re-calibrated axis zero datum following NCR-019 tool wear incident.
action_taken: Installed NSK precision angular contact bearings; calibrated toolholder runout to < 0.003 mm.

description: Flushed coolant lines, replaced high-pressure pump filter cartridge, calibrated coolant chiller thermostat to 22C.
action_taken: Installed 25-micron filtration mesh and digital flowmeter.

description: Lubricated linear guideways and ball screws. Checked hydraulic pressure relief valve.
action_taken: Replenished Mobil Vactra No. 2 slideway oil; verified 35 bar clamping pressure.

description: Addressed high tool runout causing chatter marks on cylindrical shaft journals.
action_taken: Precision ground spindle taper ID; replaced clamping collet spring pack.

description: Corrected radial offset drift observed on tool position 4 (grooving insert).
action_taken: Realigned curvic coupling; torqued clamping bolts to 85 Nm; verified repeatability.

description: Backlash error in Z-axis causing step shoulder length variation on PS-101 shafts.
action_taken: Fitted ground THK C3 grade ball screw and calibrated laser pitch compensation.

description: Dynamic unbalance detected during plunge grinding operation on precision shafts.
action_taken: Automated diamond dressing cycle completed; balanced CBN grinding wheel dynamically.

description: Installed impact damping liners in gravity chute to prevent blank denting.
action_taken: Lined vibratory spiral bowl with 4mm polyurethane to damp blank drop shock.

description: Installed automated solenoid air purge on unloader gripper to clear chips.
action_taken: Mounted dual angled nozzles with 6-bar pulse cycle prior to gripper clamping.

description: Annual UKAS/NIST traceable recalibration of inline laser diameter micrometer.
action_taken: Calibrated against Grade 0 gauge block set; repeatability confirmed to 0.0004 mm.
